notes.title: Karnataka and national affairs – detailed notes (2023 – mid-2026)
notes.md:
# Current state and national affairs

> Office-holders change – check the latest before the exam.

## Karnataka – who's who
| Post | Name |
|---|---|
| Governor | **Thaawarchand Gehlot** (July 2021) |
| Chief Minister | **D. K. Shivakumar** (sworn in **3 June 2026**) – Deputy CM **G. Parameshwara** |
| Previous CM | **Siddaramaiah** (May 2023 – resigned May 2026; longest-serving CM, Jan 2026) |
| Council Chairman | Basavaraj Horatti |
| VGIT chair (Jan 2026) | **Kris Gopalakrishnan** |
U. T. Khader, Speaker 2023–26, became Health Minister in the Shivakumar ministry.

## Five guarantees (2023)
| Scheme | Benefit |
|---|---|
| **Shakti** (11 June 2023) | Free bus travel for women in state buses |
| **Gruha Jyothi** | Up to **200 units** free electricity |
| **Gruha Lakshmi** | **₹2,000/month** to woman head of family |
| **Anna Bhagya** | 10 kg grain (5 kg rice + cash) |
| **Yuva Nidhi** | ₹3,000 (graduates) / ₹1,500 (diploma) a month to the unemployed |

## Governance and places
- **Greater Bengaluru Authority** replaced BBMP (2025), with **five corporations**.
- **Ramanagara → Bengaluru South** district (2025). Karnataka has 31 districts (Vijayanagara the 31st, 2021).
- **Kalyana Karnataka** (renamed 2019): Bidar, Kalaburagi, Yadgir, Raichur, Koppal, Ballari, Vijayanagara; **Kalyana Karnataka Utsava – 17 Sept**; Article **371J** (2012).
- **Arivu Kendras** – upgraded Gram Panchayat libraries. **KTCP** – Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act (1961).
- Caste (socio-educational) survey – Sept–Oct 2025; SC internal reservation – **Justice H. N. Nagamohan Das** commission.
- **Gig Workers (Social Security and Welfare)** law – welfare board, welfare fee from aggregators, fines (no prison term).

## Economy, technology
- **Invest Karnataka 2025** (Feb 2025); **GCC Policy 2024–29** – 500 new GCCs, ~3.5 lakh jobs.
- **KDEM – 'Beyond Bengaluru'** clusters; **B-SMILE** – SPV for big Bengaluru infrastructure (tunnel road etc.).
- **Q-City (Quantum City)** – Hesaraghatta; Karnataka Quantum Mission. **KSTePS** – Karnataka Science and Technology Promotion Society.
- Namma Metro **Yellow Line** (R. V. Road – Bommasandra, Electronic City) – Aug 2025.
- Budget 2026-27: **Vasudhamrutha** (eco-friendly, soil-health farming).

## Education and health
- **Odu Karnataka** – reading & arithmetic, classes 4–5; **Nali-Kali** – classes 1–3.
- **Yeshasvini** co-operative health scheme – Chief Patron: **Chief Minister**.

## People, culture, sport
- **Banu Mushtaq** – International Booker 2025, 'Heart Lamp' (tr. **Deepa Bhasthi**); inaugurated **Mysuru Dasara 2025**.
- **Tulsi Gowda** – 'Encyclopedia of the Forest' (Halakki tribe; d. Dec 2024). Saalumarada Thimmakka – tree planter.
- **RCB** – first IPL title, **3 June 2025**; Chinnaswamy stampede 4 June 2025 (Justice D'Cunha inquiry).
- Karnataka Ratna latest: **Puneeth Rajkumar** (posthumous).

## National
| Post / event | Fact |
|---|---|
| President | **Droupadi Murmu** (2022) |
| Vice-President | **C. P. Radhakrishnan** (Sept 2025, after Dhankhar resigned) |
| CJI | **Surya Kant** (24 Nov 2025) after B. R. Gavai |
| CEC | **Gyanesh Kumar** (Feb 2025) |
| RBI Governor | **Sanjay Malhotra** (Dec 2024) |
| CEA | V. Anantha Nageswaran |
| NHRC | Justice V. Ramasubramanian |
| GST 2.0 | 5% and 18% (+40%), from **22 Sept 2025** |
| Labour Codes | In force **21 Nov 2025** (4 codes replace 29 laws) |
| Census | Reference date **1 March 2027**, with caste enumeration |
| Space | **Shubhanshu Shukla** – Axiom-4, ISS (June–July 2025) |
| Cricket | Champions Trophy 2025 (men); **Women's ODI World Cup 2025** (beat South Africa) |
| Ports | World's first **CNG terminal** – Bhavnagar, **Gujarat** |

questions.question: In January 2026, who became the longest-serving Chief Minister in Karnataka's history?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Siddaramaiah equalled the record on 6 January 2026 and surpassed it the next day (Deccan Herald, India TV, The Federal).

questions.question: Whose record did Siddaramaiah break to become Karnataka's longest-serving Chief Minister?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Devaraj Urs held the record with 2,792 days over two terms (1972–77 and 1978–80) (Deccan Herald).

questions.question: On 6 January 2026 Siddaramaiah equalled the record tenure of how many days as Karnataka Chief Minister?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: 2,792 days ≈ 7 years 235 days. 2,113 was Urs' first term and 1,829 Siddaramaiah's first term (Deccan Herald).

questions.question: Siddaramaiah's record tenure as Chief Minister was built up over which two terms?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: First term 13 May 2013 – 15 May 2018 (1,829 days); second term from 20 May 2023 (India TV).

questions.question:
Consider the statements about D. Devaraj Urs:
I. He served two terms as Karnataka Chief Minister in the 1970s.
II. He is remembered for land reforms and social justice.
Which is/are correct?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Urs was CM from 1972 to 1977 and 1978 to 1980 and is regarded as an icon of land reforms and social justice (India TV).

questions.question: Which Karnataka personality received the Padma Bhushan in the Padma Awards 2026?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: R. Ganesh received the Padma Bhushan for art (avadhana); the others received the Padma Shri (Asianet Newsable, NewsFirst Prime).

questions.question: Shatavadhani R. Ganesh, a Padma Bhushan awardee of 2026, is famous for which art?

options.D: Avadhana, a Kannada/Sanskrit literary performance art

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: 'Shatavadhani' refers to his mastery of avadhana; he is also a scholar and writer (Asianet Newsable).

questions.question: Anke Gowda of Karnataka, awarded the Padma Shri in 2026, is known for:

options.A: Building 'Pustaka Mane', a huge free-access library near Mysuru
options.B: Planting thousands of banyan trees on highways
options.D: Running free schools for tribal children

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: A former bus conductor from Haralahalli near Mysuru, he built one of the largest private free libraries (PTI report quoted by news sites).

questions.question: How many achievers from Karnataka were named in the Padma Awards 2026 list?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: One Padma Bhushan (R. Ganesh) and seven Padma Shri awards (NewsFirst Prime, Asianet Newsable).

questions.question: T. T. Jagannathan, honoured posthumously with the Padma Shri 2026, was known in the field of:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Called the 'kitchen mogul', he led TTK Prestige for decades and invented the GRS safety system for pressure cookers (Daily Excelsior, GKToday).

questions.question: Dr Suresh Hanagavadi, a Padma Shri 2026 awardee, is recognised for medical service in which district of Karnataka?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Asianet Newsable describes his medical service in Davanagere.

questions.question:
Match the Karnataka Padma awardee (2026) with the field:
a. Shatavadhani R. Ganesh
b. Anke Gowda
c. Suresh Hanagavadi
d. T. T. Jagannathan

1. Art (avadhana)
2. Medicine
3. Trade and industry
4. Social work (library)
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: As listed in the Padma Awards 2026 announcement of 25 January 2026.

questions.question: At the joint sitting of the Karnataka Legislature on 22 January 2026, Governor Thaawarchand Gehlot:

options.B: Did not attend and sent the Speaker to read it
options.C: Read the full address prepared by the government
options.D: Read only two lines and walked out without reading the government's prepared address

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The two-line speech and walk-out became a major controversy (The Week, India TV).

questions.question: The joint session of the Karnataka Legislature from 22 January 2026 was called mainly to discuss:

options.A: The Centre's VB-G RAM G Act, which replaces MGNREGA

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The State wanted a resolution seeking the restoration of MGNREGA (Deccan Herald, Outlook).

questions.question: Which Karnataka minister, in charge of Law and Parliamentary Affairs, led the government's handling of the January 2026 joint session?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: H. K. Patil explained the session's purpose and led the delegation that met the Governor (Deccan Herald, India TV).

questions.question:
Assertion (A): In January 2026 the Karnataka Cabinet decided not to accept the VB-G RAM G Act and to challenge it legally.
Reason (R): The VB-G RAM G Act provides 125 days of wage employment per rural household.

options.A: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
options.B: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.C: A is true, but R is false
options.D: A is false, but R is true

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Both true, but the 125-day provision is not why the State opposed it; it objected to the repeal of MGNREGA and the new sharing pattern (Deccan Herald, PRS).

questions.question: In January 2026, what did the Karnataka Governor do with the Karnataka Hate Speech and Hate Crimes (Prevention and Control) Bill, 2025?

options.A: Reserved it for the consideration of the President
options.B: Referred it to the High Court
options.D: Returned it to the Assembly for re-voting

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The Governor reserved the Bill, passed in December 2025, for the President's consideration (Deccan Herald).

questions.question: A State Bill reserved by the Governor for the President's consideration is then dealt with under which Article of the Constitution?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Article 200 lets the Governor reserve a Bill; Article 201 covers the President's decision on it.

questions.question: In January 2026, the Supreme Court set a deadline of 30 June 2026 for elections to the municipal corporations under the:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The deadline was later extended, first to 31 August and then to 31 December 2026 (The South First).

questions.question: How many municipal corporations function under the Greater Bengaluru Authority?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The GBA replaced the single BBMP with five corporations (The South First).

questions.question: The Greater Bengaluru Authority replaced which earlier civic body?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The BBMP's elected council's term ended in 2020 (The South First).

questions.question: In January 2026, the Bangalore Development Authority (BDA) handed over how many of its layouts to the Greater Bengaluru Authority?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: An Urban Development Department order of January 2026 transferred eight BDA layouts to the GBA (Deccan Herald).

questions.question: In January 2026, CM Siddaramaiah said tigers straying out of forests into villages of Mysuru district would be:

options.D: Captured and relocated to other forests

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The rising tiger population near Bandipur and Nagarhole led to more sightings near villages (The Hindu, Deccan Chronicle).

questions.question: Which Karnataka tiger reserves border the villages of Mysuru district where tiger sightings rose in 2025–26?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Tigers moved out of Bandipur and Nagarhole into farmlands (Deccan Chronicle).

questions.question: The final of the Vijay Hazare Trophy 2025–26, played on 18 January 2026 at the BCCI Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru, was won by:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Vidarbha beat Saurashtra by 38 runs for their first title (ESPNcricinfo, ETV Bharat).

questions.question:
Assertion (A): Karnataka could not defend its Vijay Hazare Trophy title in 2025–26.
Reason (R): Karnataka lost to Vidarbha in the semi-final on 15 January 2026.

options.A: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
options.B: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.C: A is true, but R is false
options.D: A is false, but R is true

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The semi-final defeat ended the defending champions' campaign (ESPNcricinfo).

questions.question: From January 2026, Karnataka's Excise Department began something for the first time since it was set up in 1965. What was it?

options.C: E-auction of unused retail liquor licences
options.D: A new excise tax on milk

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The auction was expected to raise about ₹1,000 crore (The South First).

questions.question: Under the modified Anna Bhagya scheme, the extra 5 kg of rice is replaced by an 'Indira Kit'. The kit contains:

options.B: Tur dal, green gram, sugar, salt and cooking oil

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The Cabinet approved the change in October 2025 (IREF, Deccan Herald).

questions.question:
Match the Karnataka guarantee scheme with its benefit:
a. Shakti
b. Gruha Jyothi
c. Gruha Lakshmi
d. Yuva Nidhi

1. Free travel for women in state-run buses
2. Free electricity up to 200 units
3. Monthly allowance for unemployed graduates and diploma holders
4. ₹2,000 a month to the woman head of the family
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Together with Anna Bhagya these are the State's five guarantee schemes.

questions.question: Karnataka's farmer database FRUITS, used to verify farmers for government schemes, stands for:

options.A: Farm Revenue and Unified Insurance Tracking Service
options.B: Farmers' Rural Unified Income and Trade Scheme
options.C: Farmer Registration and Unified beneficiary InformaTion System
options.D: Food Resource Utilisation and Irrigation Tracking System

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Each farmer gets a FRUITS ID (FID) linked to land records, bank account and Aadhaar (NeGD, Karnataka e-Governance).

questions.question: Who were the Chief Guests at India's 77th Republic Day parade on 26 January 2026?

options.D: António Costa and Ursula von der Leyen of the European Union

questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: The top EU leadership attended together for the first time (All India Radio News).

questions.question: On 27 January 2026, at the 16th India–EU Summit in New Delhi, India and the European Union:

options.A: Concluded negotiations on a free trade agreement

questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: It is the largest trade deal either side has concluded; it still needs formal signing and ratification (European Commission, PIB).

questions.question: Which two personalities received the Padma Vibhushan 2026 posthumously?

options.C: K. T. Thomas and P. Narayanan

questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: The five Padma Vibhushan awardees were Dharmendra, V. S. Achuthanandan, N. Rajam, K. T. Thomas and P. Narayanan (The Federal).

questions.question: How many Padma awards were announced in 2026?
questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri (The Federal).

questions.question: Nitin Nabin, who took charge on 20 January 2026, became the national president of which party?
questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: He succeeded J. P. Nadda and, at 45, became the party's youngest national president (All India Radio News).

questions.question: In January 2026, the Supreme Court stayed the implementation of which regulations?
questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: The stay came on 29 January 2026 after nationwide protests (2026 in India, Wikipedia).

questions.question: The VB-G RAM G Act, which replaces MGNREGA, guarantees how many days of wage employment per rural household in a year?
questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin); MGNREGA guaranteed at least 100 days (PRS India).

questions.question: According to the World Economic Forum's Global Risks Report 2026 (21st edition), the top short-term global risk is:
questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: It rose from third place in 2025 (Drishti IAS, WEF).

questions.question: On 13 January 2026, Tamil Nadu signed an MoU with Sarvam AI to set up India's first:
questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: It aims to keep data within the State and build Tamil-language AI models (Drishti IAS).

questions.question: 'Anjadip', delivered to the Indian Navy in January 2026, is:

options.D: An Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft built by GRSE, Kolkata

questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: The third indigenous ASW-SWC, delivered at INS Adyar, Chennai (Drishti IAS).

questions.question: In February 2026, India's first private-sector helicopter Final Assembly Line was inaugurated at Vemagal in which district of Karnataka?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The Vemagal plant assembles the Airbus H125 (Drishti IAS, 23 Feb 2026; The Week).

questions.question: Which two companies set up the H125 helicopter Final Assembly Line at Vemagal?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: It is the second TASL–Airbus project in India after the C295 aircraft line at Vadodara (Drishti IAS, The Week).

questions.question: When is the first 'Made in India' Airbus H125 helicopter from Vemagal expected?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The plant is to start at about 10 helicopters a year and can also build the military H125M (The Week, airmedandrescue.com).

questions.question:
Consider the statements about the Vemagal helicopter plant:
I. It is India's first private-sector helicopter final assembly line.
II. It will build only military helicopters for the Indian Army.
Which is/are correct?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Only I. It builds the civil H125, with the capability to make the military H125M, and helicopters may be exported in South Asia (Drishti IAS, The Week).

questions.question: Background: The Tata–Airbus C295 transport aircraft facility, the partners' first joint project in India, is located at:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The Vemagal H125 line in Kolar is their second collaboration (The Week).

questions.question: 'Namma Saras Mela 2026', a national exhibition-sale of self-help group products, was held at Karavali Grounds in which city?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: It ran from 20 to 28 February 2026 (newskarnataka.com).

questions.question: SHG women from how many states took part in Namma Saras Mela 2026 at Mangaluru?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: About 120 stalls were planned for rural and urban SHG products (newskarnataka.com, quoting the Zilla Panchayat CEO).

questions.question: Namma Saras Mela 2026 was organised by the Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood together with:

options.C: The Karnataka State Rural Livelihood Mission

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The district administration, Zilla Panchayat and Mangaluru City Corporation were co-organisers (newskarnataka.com).

questions.question: 'Sakhi Auto', launched in Bengaluru on 14 February 2026, is:

options.A: A government app for auto fares
options.C: A free auto service for senior citizens
options.D: A women-only auto-rickshaw service with women drivers and women passengers

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: It followed a pilot run in January 2026 and runs from 6 am to midnight (homegrown.co.in, trucksbuses.com).

questions.question: Sakhi Auto, Bengaluru's women-only auto service, was founded by:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: She started with about 50 trained women drivers (homegrown.co.in, cmv360.com).

questions.question: In February 2026 the Karnataka Cabinet approved a hi-tech silk cocoon market for open auction of bivoltine and multivoltine cocoons at:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: ₹20 crore was sanctioned and a two-acre plot identified (NammaKPSC).

questions.question: How much did the Karnataka government sanction for the new hi-tech silk cocoon market at Mysuru?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: About 2,000–3,000 kg of cocoons are traded in Mysuru daily (NammaKPSC).

questions.question: Background: Which Karnataka town is known as 'Silk City' and has Asia's largest cocoon market?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Karnataka is India's largest producer of mulberry silk; Mysore Silk has a GI tag.

questions.question: The International Conference on Dam Safety 2026 (13–14 February) was held at:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: CM Siddaramaiah inaugurated it at IISc's J. N. Tata Auditorium; DCM D. K. Shivakumar presided (Drishti IAS).

questions.question: Background: The central law that set up the National Committee on Dam Safety and state dam safety organisations is the:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The 2026 Bengaluru conference discussed dam health monitoring under this framework.

questions.question: Hampi Utsava 2026 was held on:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Karnataka Tourism and the Incredible India portal list 13–15 February 2026.

questions.question: Background: Hampi, venue of the Hampi Utsava, is in which district and is the capital of which empire?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Vijayanagara district was carved out of Ballari in 2021; Hampi has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1986.

questions.question: The 17th Bengaluru International Film Festival (BIFFes) was held from 29 January to 6 February 2026 on which theme?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Organised by the Karnataka Chalanachitra Academy and the Department of Information (biffes.org).

questions.question: Which body organises the Bengaluru International Film Festival?

options.C: Directorate of Film Festivals, New Delhi

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Together with the state Department of Information and Public Relations (biffes.org).

questions.question: The Karnataka Tank Conservation and Development Authority (Amendment) Act, notified in February 2026, changed lake buffer zones how?

options.A: Buffer zones now vary with the size of the water body, replacing one standard 30 m zone
options.B: All buffer zones were raised to 75 m
options.C: Buffer zones were abolished for urban lakes
options.D: Only lakes above 100 acres get a buffer zone

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Previously one standard 30-metre buffer applied to all water bodies (CSIS States Weekly, 25 Feb 2026, citing Deccan Herald).

questions.question: In February 2026 the Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission allowed BESCOM to levy an additional surcharge of about ₹0.40 per unit on:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: It applies from March 2026 until the next year's surcharge order (CSIS States Weekly, citing Mercom).

questions.question: The 2025–26 Ranji Trophy final between Karnataka and Jammu & Kashmir (from 24 February 2026) was played at:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The match was drawn; J&K took the title on first-innings lead (Wikipedia, mykhel scorecard).

questions.question: Who won the 2025–26 Ranji Trophy?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: J&K made 584 and led Karnataka (293) by 291 runs on first innings (Drishti IAS, 2 Mar 2026; crictracker).

questions.question: Which Karnataka batter scored 160 in the 2025–26 Ranji Trophy final?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Karnataka were all out for 293 (kashmirreader.com, crictracker).

questions.question: Jammu & Kashmir's Auqib Nabi was Player of the Series in the 2025–26 Ranji Trophy, taking how many wickets in the season?
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: He also took five wickets in Karnataka's first innings in the final (crictracker, kashmirreader.com).

questions.question: At its meeting on 26 February 2026, the Karnataka Cabinet discussed which two draft bills and sent them back for further inputs?

options.A: The Kannada language bill and the Tulu language bill
options.B: The gig workers bill and the cinema workers bill
options.C: The honour-killing bill and the Rohith Vemula bill
options.D: The anti-conversion bill and the hate speech bill

questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: Law Minister H. K. Patil said both would return after the Home Department's inputs (careers360).

questions.question: In February 2026 Law Minister H. K. Patil announced that the Karnataka legislature's budget session would run:
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: The budget was presented on the opening day, 6 March (newskarnataka.com, PRS India).

questions.question: Siddaramaiah's budget of 6 March 2026 was his ______ budget as Finance Minister, a Karnataka record.
questions.subject: Karnataka
questions.explanation: newskarnataka.com: 'Siddaramaiah to present 17th budget on March 6' (13 Feb 2026).

questions.question:
Consider the statements:
I. Namma Saras Mela 2026 was held in Mangaluru.
II. Hampi Utsava 2026 was held in Mysuru.
Which is/are correct?
questions.subject: Karnataka

questions.question:
Assertion (A): Karnataka finished as runner-up in the 2025–26 Ranji Trophy even though the final was drawn.
Reason (R): In a drawn Ranji final, the team with the first-innings lead wins the title.

options.A: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
options.B: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.C: A is true, but R is false
options.D: A is false, but R is true

questions.explanation: J&K led by 291 runs on first innings, so they won and Karnataka were runners-up; R explains A (Wikipedia, crictracker).

questions.question: The Union Budget 2026-27, presented on 1 February 2026, set the fiscal deficit target for 2026-27 at:
questions.subject: National

questions.question: Under the Union Budget 2026-27, the new Income Tax Act, 2025 comes into effect from:
questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: It replaces the Income-tax Act, 1961 (PIB budget highlights, taxheal.com).

questions.question: The Union Budget 2026-27 announced how many high-speed rail corridors as 'growth connectors' (e.g. Mumbai–Pune, Delhi–Varanasi)?
questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: Also: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, Biopharma SHAKTI and rare-earth corridors (logicerp.com, foxmandal.in).

questions.question: The AI Impact Summit held from 16 to 20 February 2026 took place in:
questions.subject: National
questions.explanation: The 2025 AI Action Summit had been in Paris (2026 in India, Wikipedia).

questions.question: Which two wetlands were added to India's Ramsar list ahead of World Wetlands Day 2026, taking the total to 98?

questions.explanation: India had 26 Ramsar sites in 2014 and 98 in February 2026 (Drishti IAS, 2 Feb 2026).
